initialExam.title: SSB Constable 2026 (Sashastra Seema Bal)
initialExam.description: SSB Constable GD recruitment for border guarding along India-Nepal and India-Bhutan borders. A Central Armed Police Force under MHA.
initialExam.examPattern: Written: 100 questions, 100 marks, 2 hours. PET. Medical.
initialExam.selectionProcess: PST/PET → Written Test → Medical → Document Verification → Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Constable GD in SSB for border security
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → SI → Inspector → AC → DC.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ssbrectt.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Ration Money, Medical, Risk/Hardship allowance, Pension
